reason: I'd probably download the free one and snap a couple receipts, but I know me, by week two I've forgotten it exists. Paying $6 a month for something I won't open isn't happening on what I make.
objection: I don't actually track my money, I only look when something feels off, so I doubt I'd keep photographing receipts. And Notion is free with my student account.
would_change_my_mind: If it nudged me at the right moment, like after I shop, and the free tier was enough that I kept using it for a month without thinking about it.
